title: The weight of a translated varifold is the pushforward of the weight
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U and U' arbitrary subsets of R^(n+l), V a rectifiable n-varifold in U with carrier M and multiplicity theta, V' a rectifiable n-varifold in U', xi in R^(n+l), and tau(x) = x - xi. If V'.carrier = tau(M) and V'.mult(y) = theta(y + xi) for every y, then the weight measures satisfy mu_V' = tau_# mu_V, i.e. V'.weight = Measure.map tau V.weight (where V.weight is H^n restricted to M with density ofReal(theta)).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U U' : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (V' : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U') (ξ : Amb n ℓ), V'.carrier = (fun x => x - ξ) '' V.carrier → (∀ y, V'.mult y = V.mult (y + ξ)) → V'.weight = V.weight.map (fun x => x - ξ)
